pages.title: Mini Golf 3D - Island Course
pages.creator: SuperShark Studio
pages.description: Mini Golf 3D Island Course puts a putting course on a small island with ramps, rotors and wormholes. Pull back from the ball to aim and set power, then release to shoot. Use the rails for bank shots while trying to finish in fewer strokes.

pages.title: WorldGuessr
pages.creator: Coder Gautam
pages.description: WorldGuessr drops you into a location on Google Maps and asks you to work out where you are. Explore the roads for clues such as signs, coastlines, buildings and landmarks. Combine what you observe before choosing a place on the map.

pages.title: Jewel Coloring
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Jewel Coloring turns colored gems into pieces of a pixel-art picture. Select jewels and place them into cells with the matching color. Fill the entire arrangement correctly to reveal the finished image and continue to another puzzle.

pages.title: Exo Observation
pages.creator: Super Turbo Society
pages.description: Exo Observation is an incremental exploration game about researching alien planets and lifeforms. Click on areas of a world to gather different resources, then develop orbital science facilities. Manage the output as discoveries open warp gates to more of the galaxy.

pages.title: Cocktailz
pages.creator: StoreRider
pages.description: Cocktailz turns drink recipes into matching objectives. Move ingredients into groups of at least three and remove the items requested beside the board. Keep making matches to fill the gauge and trigger the Super Wave for another scoring opportunity.

pages.title: TOP HOG
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: TOP HOG puts a sleepy bear in a forest disrupted by partying hedgehogs. Use the hockey stick to send them flying, timing the swing and launch with the arrow button. Build strength and collect bonuses while working through the airborne challenges.

pages.title: Italian Brainrot Baby Clicker
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Italian Brainrot Baby Clicker turns taps into points for baby-themed meme characters. Spend the points on upgrades and activate the double-power mode to speed up progress. A two-player option lets competitors use W and the up arrow to compare tapping speed.

pages.title: Math Obby
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Math Obby combines obstacle-course movement with arithmetic questions. Jump and climb through the stages, then solve addition, subtraction, multiplication or division problems to continue. Work through both parts of each challenge to earn progress and badges.

pages.title: Traffic Cop 3D
pages.creator: Kwalee
pages.description: Traffic Cop 3D makes you a patrol officer deciding which drivers should be stopped. Scan nearby vehicles and compare the information with the police database. Choose whether to pull a driver over or let them continue as the assignments develop.

pages.title: Sniping aliens
pages.creator: HongKong WOSO Technology Co., Limited
pages.description: Sniping Aliens asks you to identify disguised invaders hidden around a city. Swipe to change your view, examine suspicious figures and aim before firing. Find the remaining aliens to clear the area rather than shooting without checking the target.

pages.title: Fashion Famous
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: Fashion Famous puts you in themed fashion contests with outfits to assemble for the runway. Move around to choose clothing, hair, makeup and accessories that fit the round's brief. Present the finished look and try to earn a higher judge score.

pages.title: Shoot N Crush
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Shoot N Crush is a ball-shooting puzzle about breaking brick arrangements. Aim a bouncing shot that reaches the level's targets and use rebounds to clear more of the structure. Adapt the shot path to each stage's particular objective.

pages.title: Fun IQ Puzzle
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Fun IQ Puzzle uses colored, bubble-like pieces in placement challenges. Solve the Story Mode arrangements to unlock closed spaces, or race the clock in Time Attack. Choose where each piece fits before moving on to the next part of the puzzle.

pages.title: Capybara Screw Jam
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Capybara Screw Jam combines colored screws with capybaras waiting in a blocked arrangement. Choose a capybara with a clear exit and match it to screws of the same color. Plan the order carefully so the available waiting positions do not fill with unusable choices.

pages.title: Zoo Shap
pages.creator: Puppy Yolk Studio
pages.description: Zoo Shap is a deduction puzzle built around shape-and-color combinations called Shaplors. Select five from the grid to guess the hidden answer key. Use the results of your choices to narrow the possibilities and improve the next guess.

pages.title: Furry Kung Fu
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Furry Kung Fu lets you fight as a cat or Babushka against park troublemakers. Strike left or right, chain repeated hits into combos and dodge incoming balls or sausages. Earn coins and achievements to unlock more appearances for the fighter.

pages.title: Doge Rush Draw Home Puzzle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Doge Rush Draw Home Puzzle asks you to draw routes that bring a dog and cat to their correct food and homes. Plan both paths before sending the animals onward. Keep them from colliding, since a crash ends the attempt.

pages.title: Mahjong Match
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Mahjong Match asks you to collect matching tiles in sets of three. Remove the identical pieces to uncover more of the board and work toward an empty layout. Think through the order so useful matches remain accessible.

pages.title: Merge Muscle
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Merge Muscle turns a gym into a character-merging challenge. Generate athletes and combine identical ones to unlock stronger trainees. Send powerful athletes into boxing competitions and click quickly during a bout to help defeat the opponent.

pages.title: Word Rivers
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description: Word Rivers combines a crossword layout with a circle of letters to connect. Drag across the available letters to spell an answer and fill its place in the puzzle. Use the completed words to help identify those still missing.

pages.title: Ball Eating Simulator
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Ball Eating Simulator puts growing balls into an arena full of things to consume. Eat to increase your size, earn coins and unlock skins while competing for dominance. Play alone or use separate movement keys to share the game with a second player.

pages.title: Stickman The Flash
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Stickman the Flash is a survival fighting game with incoming enemies and marked danger zones. Dodge the red areas and defeat opponents to collect their weapons. Spend earned gems in the equipment store to strengthen your character for later attempts.

pages.title: Kung-Fu Little Animals
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Kung Fu Little Animals makes you an assistant teaching animals martial arts. Click or tap to train each student and build progress toward the next character. Discover additional animals and locations, using bonuses when you want to accelerate the training.

pages.title: Classic Mine Sweeper
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Classic Mine Sweeper asks you to uncover safe cells without revealing a mine. Read the numbers to judge the danger in neighboring squares and mark likely mine locations. Choose a difficulty and use the clues to clear the remaining safe spaces.

pages.title: Toilet Rush
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Toilet Rush asks you to draw separate routes that take a boy and girl to the toilet. Plan around obstacles and keep their paths from crossing. Use a hint when the layout makes a safe pair of routes difficult to see.

pages.title: Skibidi Toilet IO
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description: Skibidi Toilet IO turns territory capture into a contest between toilet characters. Leave your base and return to enclose another area, keeping your own trail safe. Cross an opponent's exposed trail to eliminate them and earn points for new skins.

pages.title: Agent Walker vs Skibidi Toilets
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description: Agent Walker vs Skibidi Toilets puts you in a four-armed mechanical walker fighting hostile toilets. Move, jump and use weapons such as miniguns or grenade launchers to clear the opposition. Aim carefully and reload between encounters to keep the walker ready.

pages.title: Flick Soldier 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Flick Soldier 3D asks you to launch soldiers across a platform to knock the opposing king away. Slide to set up the move and release to send the soldier forward. Protect your own king, since losing him ends the battle.

pages.title: Cocktail Puzzle
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Cocktail Puzzle asks you to sort mixed liquids into separate glasses by color. Select a source and pour into an empty glass or onto the same top color, provided there is room. Keep useful spare space available while separating the remaining layers.

pages.title: Impostor Survivor vs Zombies
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Impostor Survivor vs Zombies puts a small fighter against crowds of attacking undead. Move through the map to avoid being overwhelmed and develop the character's abilities as the run continues. Combine skills and improvements to prepare for tougher stages.

pages.title: Metaverse Dash Run
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Metaverse Dash Run follows a runner pursued by a giant purple gorilla. Jump over the obstacles, gather unusual coins and collect power-ups along the escape route. Keep reacting to the next hazard so the pursuing creature does not end the run.

pages.title: Stick Duel: Battle Hero
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Stick Duel Battle Hero puts costumed stick fighters into weapon-based duels. Eliminate the opponent five times to win, using guns, fists or kicks along with available shields and health pickups. Choose a costume and challenge a friend with separate controls.

pages.title: Instadiva Kylie Dress Up
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Instadiva Kylie Dress Up lets you create a camera-ready look for Kylie. Choose hair, eye details, clothing and shoes, then move to the photo studio. Try different poses to capture the finished outfit from a new angle.

pages.title: Shooting Practice!
pages.creator: Realinspirer
pages.description: Shooting Practice! puts you in a shooting challenge with movement, aiming and sprint controls. Fire with the left mouse button and keep track of your health as you continue. Play further to unlock additional appearances.

pages.title: Squidly Game Hide And Seek
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Squidly Game Hide and Seek lets you choose between catching other players and escaping them. As catcher, find every escapee across three rounds. As escapee, keep moving out of reach and avoid being caught in any of the rounds.

pages.title: Eat the circles colors game
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Eat the Circles Colors Game asks you to grow a circle by consuming smaller dots. Move toward safe targets while staying clear of larger dots and stars. Keep building the circle's size without approaching something that can end the attempt.

pages.title: Football Puzzle
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Football Puzzle mixes several football challenges in one collection. Match players to their teams, answer quiz questions, predict fixture scores and arrange players on the field. Read each activity's guide before choosing how to complete the task.

pages.title: Atomic Puzzle XMas
pages.creator: HyperCarrot
pages.description: Atomic Puzzle XMas asks you to clear connected atoms in an order that leaves none behind. Select a combination containing matching-colored neighbors and consider how the remaining atoms will merge. Work through each Christmas arrangement without stranding an unusable group.

pages.title: Color Balls Game
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Color Balls Game sends colored targets down the screen toward matching firing lanes. Tap the appropriate colored line to shoot a bullet of that color at the incoming ball. Keep checking each target before choosing the next shot.

pages.title: Impossible Car Stunt 2022
pages.creator: Game Ashlar
pages.description: Impossible Car Stunt 2022 puts a car on narrow stunt tracks high above the ground. Use WASD to steer through the elevated route and handle its difficult sections. Control the approach to each turn so the car stays on the course.

pages.title: Jewel Christmas Mania
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Jewel Christmas Mania asks you to match festive items while working toward a score target. Make groups of three to clear pieces, or larger combinations to create bombs. Complete the objective before the level's moves or time run out.

pages.title: Drift Ice Line Connect
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Drift Ice Line Connect helps Pengu join icy platforms into one complete loop. Plan a route that uses each ice section only once. Think through the full layout before moving so a finished section does not leave another platform disconnected.

pages.title: Love Story Diana Dress Up
pages.creator: DESIGN GAMES INC
pages.description: Love Story Diana Dress Up gives you daily styling challenges with rewards to collect. Color and arrange the character's hair, apply makeup and coordinate clothing with accessories. Complete the requested look to earn badges and stickers while building a wardrobe of saved styles.

pages.title: Bread Pit
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Bread Pit follows a slice of bread trying to reach the toaster. Work through the route while keeping it away from forks, knives and other traps. Help the little slice make it through the obstacles and become toast.

pages.title: Carpenter
pages.creator: ConchGame
pages.description: Carpenter lets you turn wooden boards into painted models. Follow the cutting process, avoid obstacles and shape the wood into the required design. Add color to complete the finished creation before moving to another project.

pages.title: Tap2Block
pages.creator: Pixymaze Softworks Ltd
pages.description: Tap2Block puts a rolling ball into a collection challenge. Gather the blue blocks while keeping the ball from dropping away. React to its movement and choose the next safe action so the attempt can continue.

pages.title: Wood Tower
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Wood Tower challenges you to stack moving pieces of timber into a tall structure. Tap to drop the current piece when it lines up with the wood below. Keep the pile balanced as you add another layer to the tower.

pages.title: Cold Drink Mahjong Connection
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Cold Drink Mahjong Connection asks you to link pairs of identical drink tiles. Find a clear route using no more than two right-angle turns and remove the matching pictures. Open paths through the board to reach the pairs that remain.

pages.title: Crash Landing 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Crash Landing 3D asks you to guide an aircraft through takeoff and landing challenges. Use mouse clicks or taps to control the flight and judge the approach to the landing area. Work toward a better result without crashing the plane.

pages.title: Funny Animal Ride Difference
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Funny Animal Ride Difference asks you to compare paired ride pictures and select the details that do not match. Search the scenes before the level's timer expires. Keep checking the smaller objects when only a few differences remain.

pages.title: Angry Bull Attack Wild Hunt Simulator
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Angry Bull Attack Wild Hunt Simulator puts a wild bull into a city threatened by its rampage. Control the animal through the streets while people and police try to stop it. Use the on-screen controls to continue the destruction and avoid being brought down.

pages.title: Kill The Buddy
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Kill the Buddy is a cartoon physics challenge about bringing a piano down onto a target character. Interact with the scene to make the instrument fall into place. Work out the action that completes the stage's piano-drop objective.

pages.title: Stormy Kicker
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Stormy Kicker makes a football shot depend on one well-timed tap. Wait until the incoming ball reaches the red target, then click to kick toward goal. Keep landing the timing as you help the team progress toward a tournament title.

pages.title: Echo Simon
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Echo Simon challenges you to remember and reproduce an expanding sequence. Watch the pattern carefully, then select the same order yourself. Keep repeating the new sequences to extend the run and improve the score.

pages.title: Water Slide Car Racing Sim
pages.creator: Pixel Studio
pages.description: Water Slide Car Racing Sim puts cars on long water-slide tracks for timed driving challenges. Steer with WASD and keep the vehicle on the route while working toward the finish. Try the available missions and modes for another course to complete.

pages.title: Impossible Truck Tracks Drive Game
pages.creator: toplight studio
pages.description: Impossible Truck Tracks Drive Game puts large trucks on elevated routes with little room for mistakes. Steer through the narrow sections and keep the vehicle aligned with the track. Judge the next bend before carrying too much speed into it.

pages.title: Truck Hill Drive Cargo Simulator Game
pages.creator: toplight studio
pages.description: Truck Hill Drive Cargo Simulator Game gives you heavy loads to deliver across rough terrain. Drive from the loading point toward the destination while keeping the truck under control. Adjust your speed for difficult hills and narrow sections along the route.

pages.title: Rescue the rabbit
pages.creator: games2mad
pages.description: Rescue the Rabbit traps a rabbit inside a forest house. Search the rooms for hidden objects and clues, then solve the puzzles that open its escape route. Work out where each discovery belongs to free the animal.

pages.title: Iniya Dress Up
pages.creator: games2mad
pages.description: Iniya Dress Up helps Iniya choose clothing for a shopping trip. Browse the available wardrobe and select pieces that work together for the outing. Compare the options until you have completed her finished look.

pages.title: Hurdle track Car Stunts
pages.creator: gameworld
pages.description: Hurdle Track Car Stunts combines track driving with shooting obstacles out of the way. Move the car along the course and fire at the hurdles blocking progress. Clear a route through the barriers to reach the finish line.

pages.title: Christmas Fun Hidden Stars
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Christmas Fun Hidden Stars asks you to locate ten stars in each Christmas picture. Search the scene before the timer expires and select only the concealed targets. Repeated incorrect clicks subtract time, so check a shape before choosing it.

pages.title: Christmas Cupcake Match 3
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Christmas Cupcake Match 3 asks you to arrange same-colored pieces into groups of three or more. Clear combinations to build your score while watching the meter beside the board. Keep finding matches before that supply falls too low.

pages.title: EG Red Ball
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Red Ball asks you to transfer a small red ball from one pocket to another. Rotate rebound blocks to change its direction and plan around gates, movable pieces and teleports. Set up a route that delivers the ball to the destination pocket.

pages.title: Racing Rocket 2
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: Racing Rocket 2 puts upgradeable vehicles into fast driving challenges. Accelerate with the right arrow, brake with the left and adjust direction with the up arrow. Earn gold from races and use it to improve the car or purchase another vehicle.

pages.title: Merry Christmas 2019 Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Merry Christmas 2019 Slide offers three festive pictures to restore as sliding puzzles. Select an image and one of the available modes, then move the scrambled sections into place. Match the picture details while planning around the open space.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Christmas Time
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Christmas Time joins Hazel and her friends as they prepare for Santa's visit. Pack gifts, build a snowman and take part in winter activities such as snowboarding and snow fights. Help the group finish the preparations before the celebration.

pages.title: Happy Glass Halloween Edition
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Happy Glass Halloween Edition turns filling a glass into a drawing puzzle with a spooky red liquid. Sketch lines that guide the flow around obstacles and into the container. Bring enough liquid to the glass to complete the level.

pages.title: Xtreme Speed Stunts BMX
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Xtreme Speed Stunts BMX puts a bike on tracks built for riding and stunts. Control it with WASD and work through the route's turns and obstacles. Practice each approach so you can continue the ride after the next maneuver.

pages.title: Halloween Board Puzzles
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Halloween Board Puzzles asks you to find the single difference between two nearly identical boards. Scan their arrangements and tap the mismatching detail before time runs out. Keep reacting quickly as a new pair of boards appears.

pages.title: Pistols And Bottles
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Pistols and Bottles gives you a limited supply of ammunition for bottle targets. Time and aim the shots to break the bottles without wasting bullets. Check the next opportunity before firing so the remaining ammunition can finish the challenge.

pages.title: Gold Miner Jack 2
pages.creator: crazyschoolgames
pages.description: Gold Miner Jack 2 asks you to time a swinging hook to collect gold and diamonds underground. Send it toward a valuable target and bring the catch back before the timer runs out. Use the earnings in the shop to prepare for later levels.

pages.title: MotoGP Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: MotoGP Puzzle turns six motorcycle-racing pictures into jigsaws. Choose a 16-, 36-, 64- or 100-piece version, then reconnect the rider, bike and surroundings. Try a larger arrangement when you want a more detailed assembly.

pages.title: Dino Meat Hunt Dry Land
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Dino Meat Hunt Dry Land pairs two dinosaurs with different strengths for a meat-collecting adventure. Use the small dinosaur's high jumps and the larger one's attacks to get past traps and monsters. Coordinate their routes to solve the levels together.

pages.title: Find The Paris
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Find the Paris is a timed picture-pairing puzzle. Reveal grid cells, remember the pictures and find their matching partners. Clear the pairs before the time limit and try to finish quickly enough for a better star result.

pages.title: Glisser.io
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Glisser.io sends your boat through a chase with hostile mafia boats. Collect fuel, use turbo to gain distance and avoid bombs or acid trails left by pursuers. Keep finding open water to survive longer without being caught.

pages.title: Fishing Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Fishing Jigsaw lets you earn game money by assembling fishing pictures. Complete the first image and save enough to purchase another from the gallery. Harder puzzle modes pay more, giving you another way to work toward the remaining pictures.

pages.title: Hand Doctor
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Hand Doctor is a fictional clinic game about attending to injured hands. Follow the prompts and select the pictured tools for each treatment activity. Work through the different injuries until the current patient's visit is complete.

pages.title: EG Fidget Spinner
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Fidget Spinner gives you a virtual spinner to control on the screen. Set it moving and watch the rotation as you continue interacting. Try another spin to experiment with the motion.

pages.title: Princess Christmas Beards
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Princess Christmas Beards turns a magical mishap into a beard-styling makeover. Decorate Ariel, Jasmine and Mulan's unexpected facial hair, then coordinate clothes and hairstyles to complete their festive looks.

pages.title: Pixel Linker
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Pixel Linker asks you to join matching colors across a grid. Draw paths between the corresponding points and plan how each connection uses the space. Complete the required links without leaving another color's route out of reach.

pages.title: Besties Dotted Fashion
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Besties Dotted Fashion helps Rapunzel and Moana create coordinated dotted looks. Choose patterned outfits for the two friends, then give their nails a matching design. Combine the available choices to complete both makeovers.

pages.title: Soccer Physics 2
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Soccer Physics 2 turns football into an unpredictable physics match. Control the team and try to get the ball into the opposing goal while defending your own. Play against the computer, a second local player or an online opponent.

pages.title: Hearts
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Hearts asks you to finish a card game with the lowest point total. Choose your plays to avoid collecting unwanted scoring cards. The game ends when someone reaches one hundred points, and the player with the fewest points wins.

pages.title: Vikings Tavern
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Vikings Tavern puts thirsty Vikings at your counter waiting for beer. Send drinks to the customers and retrieve their empty glasses before the service gets out of control. Watch for especially thirsty visitors and keep the lines supplied before they lose patience.

pages.title: Gone Fishing
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Gone Fishing asks you to cast a line and collect fish as the hook returns upward. Guide the retrieval through the available catches and try to bring more back. Judge the route to make the next fishing attempt more productive.

pages.title: Pie Realife Cooking
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Pie Realife Cooking lets you prepare and decorate a fruit pie. Work with ingredients such as banana, kiwi, strawberries and pineapple, then watch the pie bake. Arrange the finishing touches to give the dessert a design of your own.

pages.title: E Switch
pages.creator: Gamesign Studio
pages.description: E Switch is a connection puzzle about linking green areas on a board. Rotate chips or exchange their positions to make the routes line up. Consider how each change affects neighboring pieces while completing the full connection.

pages.title: Halloween Madness
pages.creator: FluffyFoxGames
pages.description: Halloween Madness sends you fleeing from approaching zombies. Move away from the threats and keep finding room to escape their pursuit. Survive as long as possible while reacting to the next group closing in.

pages.title: Fashion Fall Checklist
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Fashion Fall Checklist takes Ariel shopping with a list of autumn wardrobe items to find. Visit the boutiques and look for the requested pieces. Use the collected clothing to build a new seasonal look for the princess.

pages.title: Splish Drago Pong
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Splish Drago Pong puts Drago and other swimming creatures between two barriers. Control their movement and stay clear of the enemies sharing the space. Keep the creature alive as it travels back and forth through the area.

pages.title: My Dolphin Show 6
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: My Dolphin Show 6 puts you in an aquarium performance with jumps, tricks and stunts to complete. Guide the dolphin through the activities and work through the show's next challenge. Keep the performance moving as the routine introduces another maneuver.

pages.title: 1001 Arabian Nights
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: 1001 Arabian Nights combines a desert treasure journey with gem-matching boards. Swap gems to form matching groups and clear space around collectible pieces. Work through the arrangements to gather the treasure and continue the journey.

pages.title: Shimmer and Shine Coloring Book
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Shimmer and Shine Coloring Book gives you drawings of the two genies to decorate. Select a picture, choose colors and fill its different areas. Use the glitter spray bottle to add a sparkling finish as you work through the book.
